doc: Converts a 32-bit value whose 4-bit nibbles each hold a decimal digit (0-9) into the equivalent base-10 integer: for i=0..7, extracts nibble i (mask 0xF<<(4i)), multiplies by pow10=10^i while still shifted into position, then arithmetic-shifts the 32-bit truncated product back down by 4i and accumulates. Net effect (assuming valid BCD-like input) is sum = Σ digit_i * 10^i.
